about: The windows the voice cases read, made from integer recipes (export-deck-vectors.cjs recipeChannel; DeckVoiceTests makes them the same way): 8 s at `rate`, each sample an Int16 over 32768 - noise (xorshift32 seeded seed * 2 + channel + 1, its top 16 bits less 32768; soft: that shifted right 3), sweep (a triangle whose step is 1 + ((i >> 7) % 600) * (channel + 1)), clicks (+32767 then -32768 every 2400 + 7 seed + 331 channel samples), step (silence, then 32767 on the first channel and -32768 on the second from half way, the second 9601 samples later). `hash`: FNV-1a 64 of the channels' Float32 bits in order, little-endian.
